visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with round glasses and a light green t-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway, speaking directly to the camera with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. He then transitions to sitting at a wooden table, holding a plastic tray of sliced raw tuna and pointing at the label. (2) He enters a modern kitchen with a large silver refrigerator, which he opens to browse for ingredients. Shortly after, he begins jogging in place barefoot on a light-colored wooden floor while continuing his monologue. (3) A sequence of close-up shots shows his hands preparing the meal: slicing the fish, chopping red peppers and garlic on a wooden board. He then cooks in a white ceramic pot on a gas stove, adding broth and large pieces of cabbage. (4) While the food simmers, he is seen jogging again in the kitchen area. He finishes the dish by adding the tuna slices and a garnish of green onions and sesame seeds. (5) He sits down with the large steaming pot and a glass of tea. He uses chopsticks to eat the cabbage and fish, reacting with surprise to the taste and eventually showing signs of being very full.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This vlog documents day 14 of a 100-day weight loss journey. The creator shares a relatable struggle of oversleeping and missing a workout, then demonstrates problem-solving by exercising at home while watching a drama, followed by preparing a low-calorie tuna and cabbage soup to maintain his diet goals.
